title: and I thought I missed my chance to ever see alex do it. thanks @broa...
transcript: I was supposed to play the Leading Player in my high school production of Pippin and I couldn't because I was filming Glee at the time and I was heartbroken I was like devastated I've turned up fine but I was perfectly fine it's fine guys I though I’d miss my opportunity to ever get to play it and the only thing that I can say that it fueled me was you always wanna do great by the work that was created and I think while doing so many things in the short short short process that we had to uh create this it was I just need to do right by the original work and so that's what got me and kept me going and this amazing cast and company that I get to do it with it's wonderful the opening number is wonderful and you're magnificent in it you make me proud thank you that's all you want to hear that's all when the legends are still living that's what you want to hear yes yes right
